per_candidate.id: s2:C/O Ratio Studies in the atmosphere of hot Jupiters
s2:A Review on the Effects of Thermal Inversions and Electromagnetic Fields on Cell

rationale: Paper 2301.08192 presents a thermal emission spectrum of WASP-18b, contributing new evidence on the atmospheric properties of ultra-hot Jupiters, which is relevant to understanding discrepancies in C/O ratios and thermal inversions. However, it does not fully resolve the question.
